sql.choose: Select the .env file for the existing SQL Server connection

sql.help: After confirmation, the app will display SQL Server records. SQLite will be inactive and its records preserved. The databases will not be merged.
sql.fileHelp: Use the .env file already used by the previous version. Credentials are read only by the main process.

notifications.subtitle: Choose when JourneyHub should remind you to start your workday.
reference.help: The target applies on weekdays starting tomorrow. Past workdays and today keep their previous target.
reference.migration: Ask your administrator to apply the daily target migration to this database.
data.title: Your data
data.help: Workdays are stored in the active database: SQLite on this computer or your configured SQL Server. Each SQL database must belong to one person; access is not separated by user. Trash retains workdays, breaks and history until restoration. SQLite backups include notes, reasons and previous versions and are not encrypted by the app. Keep them in a protected location. The hours summary excludes these texts; export with history includes the full data.
sql.singleUser: Use a separate database per person. Everyone connected to the same database can view its history.
